text: AdventureWorksDW2014 is already well-built, so this cleanup is lighter than Chapter Three — but it isn't nothing.
Three real tasks. Decide for real which of Lesson 85's extra columns to keep. Rename warehouse names into something a report can show. Confirm every date column actually loaded as a date.
One check that catches mistakes early: renaming and removing columns should never change a table's row count. If it did, a stray filter step snuck in.
Close and Apply commits it all. Lesson 87 is where these cleaned tables actually become a star schema.
